quirks.summary: keyVal reads like 'DCAPR_178876', with an underscore, not the usual 13-character uppercase token.
quirks.detail: A keyVal grep of [A-Z0-9]+ stops at 'DCAPR', and every documents tab then opens on a non-existent case and lists no files. That fits the 2026-09-16 survey record 'documents tab had no file links'.
quirks.workaround: Match keyVal=([^&"'\s]+), i.e. everything up to the next separator.

quirks.summary: Search-result metadata is separated by '|', not the U+00B7 middle dot seen on other Idox installs.
quirks.detail: All 52 <span class="divider"> elements on a results page held '|'. A parser that splits only on U+00B7 gets the reference with the received and validated dates still attached.
quirks.workaround: Take the reference from 'Ref. No:' up to the first divider span, whichever character it holds.

browser_route.note: Search the reference in a browser.

pacing.note: Six requests to the portal host at 5-6 s spacing on 2026-09-29, no 429 or challenge.
